text.en:
Adoption of the Alert Level System. The Alert Level System
(ALS) is hereby adopted for nationwide rollout, to be undertaken in four (4) phases.
The pilot areas in which the ALS is already being implemented as of the date of
effectivity of this Order shall be deemed as the first phase of the nationwide
implementation, while other regions shall follow in the succeeding phases, to wit:

NCR, Region IlI, IV-A, VI, VII, X and XI
Region I, VIll and XII
Region II, V, IX
Cordillera Administrative Region (CAR), Region IV-B, Region XIII
(CARAGA), and the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim
Mindanao (BARMM)
The shift to Phase 2 may begin at any time after the effectivity of this Order, as
may be determined by the IATF, but not later than the end of November 2021. The
succeeding phases shall then commence every week thereafter until full nationwide
implementation.

Guidelines on the Implementation of the ALS. The "Guidelines
on the Implementation of Alert Levels System for COVID-19 Response in Pilot Areas,"
with the amendments thereto approved by the IATF as of the effectivity of this Order,
is hereby adopted as the guidelines that shall be implemented and enforced in all
areas to be placed under the ALS in its nationwide rollout. The said Guidelines shall
be renamed accordingly to reflect its new status.
The IATF is hereby authorized to amend or modify such Guidelines as may be
necessary to achieve the objectives of the ALS, without need of further approval of the

Transitory Provision. Pending the full nationwide implementation
of the ALS, the Omnibus Guidelines for the Implementation of Community Quarantine
in the Philippines, approved through EO No. 112 (s. 2020), shall remain in effect in all
areas not yet placed under the ALS.

Assistance and Cooperation of Agencies and LGUs. All
departments, agencies and instrumentalities of the government, including state
colleges and universities, government-owned or -controlled corporations, government
financial institutions, and LGUs are directed to render full assistance to and
cooperation with the lATF and mobilize the necessary resources for the
implementation of the ALS pursuant to this Order.

Separability. If any part of this Order is held unconstitutional or
invalid, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain in full force and effect.

Repeal. EO No. 112 (s. 2020) shall be deemed repealed once all
areas of the country are placed under the ALS. All other orders, rules, regulations and
issuances, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Order are hereby repealed,
amended or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in the Official Gazette or a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 11 thy of November in the year of Our Lord,
Two Thousand and Twenty-one.
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
